review.corrected_sql:
-- Payment method performance (corrected)

SELECT 
    PAYMENT_METHOD,
    COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TRANSACTIONS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAILED_TRANSACTIONS,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*)) AS FAILURE_RATE
FROM FACT_TRANSACTIONS
GROUP BY PAYMENT_METHOD
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
review.summary: The query had a critical correctness issue with the failure rate calculation and minor readability issues. The corrected query now accurately calculates the failure rate and includes more descriptive column aliases.
